seed: Start from the transitions where an action produced no change at all. Find what blocked the action in each case and write the blocking condition before the movement rule.

synth.notes:
Player 5x5 moves 5 cells per arrow; blocking guard first: dest blocked if off-board or any colour-4 wall / colour-5 void cell (explains every no-change move).
Conveyor: a 5-cell colour-1 strip just outside a dest edge slides the player on until blocked.
step_bar burns 2 leftmost cells (11->3) per arrow incl. blocked ones; covering a ring refills it.
Covering a collect object rotates the 3x3 HUD glyph 90 CW; object restored when uncovered (continuity-gated memory).
Unconfirmed: chamber rejects while glyph != legend; recolor token -> colour 9.
